digest.component_or_area: ticket summary resolver and agent interface
propositions: summary_compute resolves ticket state through show_state but omits the resolved alias from its return payload, returning only the caller-supplied ticket_id
agents preferentially copy locally-salient four-character prefixes from summaries instead of human-friendly aliases despite aliases being available in the resolver output
the summary schema, library, CLI, and MCP contracts institutionalize an alias-free shape, making canonical aliases unavailable to consumers

adding the exact resolved alias as an additive field to summary results and affirming agent guidance to prefer aliases for tracker commands changes identifier selection from 25/25 prefixes to 25/25 aliases in controlled behavioral evaluation
